theorems.name: Submission.dtc_cone_of_constant_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (θ : ℝ), 0 < n → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → BoundaryVanishes C → (∀ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.Represents C → R.IsStationaryAlong univ) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → C.massOn (ball 0 ρ) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * ENNReal.ofReal θ) → IsConeCurrent C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
